ConnectionStrings.//: Supply the local dev connection string via user-secrets (dotnet user-secrets) or an environment variable. Do NOT commit passwords. See docs/security/dev-setup.md.

Jwt.//: Supply the dev signing key via user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SigningKey" "<32+ random bytes>". Startup fails fast when it is missing or a known placeholder.

Dev.//: Enables the X-Dev-User-Id / X-Dev-Tenant-Id impersonation headers for local API testing. Honoured ONLY in Development; the host refuses to start with this enabled in any other environment.
